title: Restore the issuing authority from protected storage
spec: Allow a callback to borrow only the issuing authority's PKCS#8 bytes for encrypted custody. Reopen an issuer from its exact DER certificate, a pinned root DER and the decrypted PKCS#8 in memory. Reject malformed DER, inappropriate authority constraints, certificates outside their validity periods, a bad root or chain signature, and a private key that is malformed, uses the wrong algorithm or fails to match the issuer. Newly signed server and device certificates still chain under the same root after a restart. Keep key bytes out of Debug and leave filesystem custody and durable device admission to callers.
